description: The kitchen tap has been dripping for three days and now there is water pooling under the sink.
A pipe burst behind the bathroom wall last night, water is running down into the passage.
The toilet will not flush properly and keeps filling up with dirty water.
Water drains very slowly in the shower and the drain smells bad.
The geyser is leaking from the bottom and the ceiling board above it is wet.
There is almost no water pressure in the whole house since yesterday morning.
Sewage is coming up through the floor drain outside the kitchen door.
The water tank stand is broken and the tank is leaning, I need someone to fix the plumbing and the stand.
The shower mixer is loose and water sprays out from the joint when I turn it on.
Please help, the outside tap was left open and now the yard is flooded and the pipe connection is broken.
The socket in the bedroom sparked when I plugged in the heater and now that side of the house is dead.
The main breaker keeps tripping every few minutes, I have to keep resetting it.
The lights in the sitting room flicker badly whenever the fridge starts.
There is a burning smell coming from the distribution board and one switch is warm.
No electricity in the house at all but the neighbours have power, the meter is showing nothing.
The plug on the iron melted into the extension cord, the plug point needs replacing.
I need new wiring for a small extension, two rooms and a bathroom light.
The security light outside stays on all day and does not come on at night anymore.
The wall switch in the corridor gives a shock when I touch it with wet hands.
The prepaid meter is beeping and the display shows an error, no power is coming through.
My car will not start in the morning, it just clicks and nothing happens.
The brakes are grinding when I stop and the pedal goes down too far.
I have a punctured tyre and the spare is also flat, I need help on the roadside.
The engine temperature gauge goes into the red after ten minutes of driving.
The clutch is slipping badly, the car revs but does not move properly.
The battery keeps going flat overnight even after I replaced it.
There is a knocking noise from the suspension when I go over bumps.
The gearbox is hard to engage in second gear and grinds sometimes.
The alternator is not charging, the battery light stays on while driving.
A stone cracked the windscreen on the driver side, I need it replaced before the rains.
The air conditioner in the bedroom is running but it is not cooling at all.
I need routine servicing for two split air conditioning units before the hot season.
The aircon needs a gas refill, it stopped blowing cold air last week.
The duct vents in the office are blowing dust and the airflow is very weak.
The air conditioner is dripping water onto the floor from the indoor unit.
I want a new split unit installed in the sitting room, the wall bracket is already there.
The thermostat on the aircon does not respond, it stays on the same setting.
The ceiling extractor fan in the bathroom stopped working and the room stays damp.
The air conditioner makes a loud rattling noise when it starts up.
The heating unit in the guest house is blowing cold air instead of warm air.
The washing machine fills with water but the drum does not spin.
The microwave runs but does not heat the food anymore.
The stove oven will not light and I smell gas when I turn the knob.
The dishwasher leaves water standing in the bottom after every cycle.
My steam iron stopped producing steam and the plate is not heating.
The vacuum cleaner motor is screaming and there is no suction.
The blender blade spins but the jug leaks at the base.
The tumble dryer takes three hours to dry a small load and gets very hot.
The electric kettle switches itself off before the water boils.
The cooker hob has two plates that no longer heat up, only the small one works.
The fridge is running constantly but the food inside is warm.
The freezer has a thick layer of ice and the door will not close properly.
The cold room at the butchery is not holding temperature overnight.
The display chiller in the shop is warm on the bottom shelf.
The freezer compressor is hot and humming but not starting up.
There is water leaking from under the fridge onto the kitchen floor.
The deep freeze stopped working after the power came back on.
The fridge door seal is torn so cold air escapes and it runs all day.
The drinks cooler in the bar is not getting cold, the fan is noisy.
The bar fridge thermostat is broken, everything freezes solid on the bottom shelf.
The television switches on but the screen stays black with no picture.
The home theatre amplifier has no sound on the left channel.
The radio receiver only picks up one station and there is heavy static.
My soundbar pairs but the volume buttons on the remote do nothing.
The LED television has dark patches along the bottom edge of the screen.
The game console overheats and shuts down after twenty minutes of play.
The CCTV camera at the gate shows a grey image at night.
The speakers crackle badly when I turn the volume above half.
The DVD player refuses to read discs, it says no disc every time.
The digital camera will not charge and the battery indicator flashes red.
My laptop is extremely slow and the fan runs loud all the time.
The wifi router shows a red light and no devices can connect.
The office printer is offline and jobs stay stuck in the queue.
I need Microsoft Office installed and the laptop set up for the new semester.
The desktop computer beeps and shows a disk error on start up.
Our small office network drops every afternoon and we lose internet.
The computer has a virus, adverts keep opening by themselves in the browser.
I cannot send email from Outlook, it keeps asking for the password.
The external hard drive is not recognised by any of my computers.
We need the shop till software updated and a backup taken of the sales data.
I need someone to assemble a flat pack wardrobe and mount it to the wall.
The kitchen door hinge is broken and the door hangs off the frame.
The sitting room needs painting, the walls are peeling near the window.
Some floor tiles in the bathroom came loose and two are cracked.
The plaster on the passage wall is crumbling and needs patching before painting.
The metal gate at the entrance is sagging and does not close all the way.
I want a curtain rail fitted across the bedroom window and the curtains hung.
The wooden fence panels at the back are rotten and need replacing.
A shelf collapsed in the pantry, I need new brackets fitted and the shelf rehung.
The burglar bars on the bedroom window are loose in the wall and rattle at night.
